  MAP
  tokens    Framer tokens on body (--token-...): red #da2114 / #b10c08, ink #161616 / #111, white, grey #787878 / #b9b9b9,

<style id="fw-footer">
.fwf{position:relative;z-index:3;width:100%;max-width:100%;align-self:stretch;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;background:#140707;font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans","Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;isolation:isolate}
.fwf-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:-1;display:block}
.fwf-belt{display:block;width:100%;height:60px}
.fwf-in{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;box-sizing:border-box;padding:96px 40px 28px}
.fwf-eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 22px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#ffb3a6}
.fwf-eyebrow span{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff5a42;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ff5a42}
.fwf-cta h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(48px,8vw,112px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(70,0,0,.35)}
.fwf-btn{margin-top:40px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;min-width:min(420px,100%);padding:20px 28px;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,225,220,.7);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(150,12,8,.55),rgba(105,4,3,.6));
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,90,70,.18),0 0 28px rgba(255,70,50,.35),0 14px 34px rgba(60,0,0,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.5,1),box-shadow .3s}
.fwf-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,120,100,.35),0 0 40px rgba(255,80,60,.5),0 18px 40px rgba(60,0,0,.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.fwf i{display:inline-flex;width:20px;height:20px;font-style:normal}.fwf i svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.fwf-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:40px;margin-top:96px;padding-top:40px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,140,120,.25)}
.fwf-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.fwf-col h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#ff9e8e}
.fwf-col a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:17px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:fit-content;position:relative;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.fwf-col a i{width:14px;height:14px;opacity:.6;transition:transform .25s,opacity .25s}
.fwf-col a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-3px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.5,1)}
.fwf-col a:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.fwf-col a:hover i{transform:translate(2px,-2px);opacity:1}
.fwf-muted{margin:0;color:rgba(255,225,220,.68);font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}
.fwf-form{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;padding:6px 6px 6px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,225,220,.45);
  background:rgba(40,4,3,.35);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 10px 30px rgba(40,0,0,.3);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.fwf-form input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:none;border:0;outline:0;color:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:15px;padding:10px 0}
.fwf-form input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,225,220,.55)}
.fwf-form button{flex:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#3a0603;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#e9e3de);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12),0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.fwf-form:focus-within{border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,90,70,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.fwf-ok{display:none;position:absolute;left:18px;top:100%;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:#ffd2c9}
.fwf-form.done .fwf-ok{display:block}
.fwf-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
.fwf-mark{margin:90px -4px 0;padding-bottom:.06em;overflow:hidden;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:.98;font-size:clamp(56px,19.5vw,300px);white-space:nowrap;user-select:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0%,rgba(255,200,190,.55) 55%,rgba(255,120,100,0) 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 30px rgba(80,0,0,.35))}
.fwf-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,140,120,.25);font-size:14px}
.fwf-bar a{color:#fff}
.fwf-top{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;color:#fff;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,225,220,.6);background:rgba(120,8,5,.45);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,70,50,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);transition:transform .3s}
.fwf-top svg{width:18px;height:18px}.fwf-top:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
@media (max-width:1023px){.fwf-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:640px){.fwf-in{padding:64px 16px 24px}.fwf-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px;margin-top:64px}.fwf-btn{width:100%;min-width:0}.fwf-mark{margin-top:56px}.fwf-bar{gap:10px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fwf-belt animateTransform{display:none}}
</style>
<style id="fw-static">
.fw-anchor{flex:none;width:100%;height:0;scroll-margin-top:0}

.fw-menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 0% 100%,#b10c08 0,#5a0805 38%,#140707 75%);color:#fff;font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans","Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:auto;animation:fwMenu .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}

.fw-menu-x{align-self:flex-end;background:none;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,225,220,.6);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font:inherit;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}

.fw-menu nav a{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:18px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,92px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1.05;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,140,120,.25);transition:color .2s,padding .3s}
.fw-menu nav a span{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#ff9e8e}

.fw-menu .fwf-btn{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start}
[data-fw-btn]{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}
.fw-sent{opacity:.85}
.framer-PD4lq .framer-1q4zzp3,.framer-PD4lq .framer-1ii6jgm,.framer-PD4lq .framer-11mpilz{transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.framer-9LO4k .framer-1h7sjn9,.framer-9LO4k .framer-rvc33l,.framer-9LO4k .framer-1ozqyzh,.framer-9LO4k .framer-5rod2n,.framer-9LO4k .framer-1r0rh4j{transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.fw-swap{transition:opacity .25s}.fw-swap.out{opacity:0}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fw-menu{animation:none}*{transition:none!important}}

var w=40+60*t,h=50+50*t,cy=140-90*t;
box.style.cssText='bottom:auto;width:'+w+'%;height:'+h+'%;left:'+((100-w)/2)+'%;top:'+(cy-h/2)+'%';}
